description: Public country routing data; single source for DNS Host/script generation and country rule validation. No private proxy or user configuration data.

mcc_scope.basis: Only national MCCs already present in the baseline country list and confirmed against ITU E.212 allocations.
mcc_scope.limits: MCC identifies the allocated home network namespace, not the physical server country. Extra-territorial networks and shared IP gateways can still need explicit exceptions. Unknown MCCs retain normal routing. Both national 3gppnetwork suffixes are broader than ePDG alone and preserve/extend the original cellular-services scope.

3gpp_naming.supports: TS 23.003 sections 19.4.2.9.2 and .3 define epdg.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org with both codes three digits; supports hostname interpretation, not proof of any particular deployed endpoint.

apple_verizon_ota.supports: Directly downloaded Apple OTA iPhone carrier bundle contains spc.myvzw.com under CarrierEntitlements.ServerAddress and spc-pfe.myvzw.com under CarrierEntitlementsSecondaryOverlay.ServerAddress.
apple_verizon_ota.note: Third-party index used only to discover the Apple CDN URL. Actual evidence extracted from original Apple-hosted ZIP/plists; no user config involved. OTA package is dated 2026-03-24, not asserted to be newest iOS bundle.

arcep_fr_mnc.supports: French regulator lists SFR 208 10 and Bouygues Telecom 208 20.

aruba_jio.supports: Built-in Wi-Fi Calling DNS pattern maps Reliance Jio to vowifi.jio.com.

aruba_wifi_defaults.supports: Built-in Wi-Fi Calling DNS patterns map 3 HK to wlan.three.com.hk and Verizon to wo.vzwwo.com.

itu_au_mnc.supports: Annex Australia assigns 505 01 to Telstra and 505 03 to Vodafone.

itu_mx_mnc.supports: January 2025 amendment assigns Mexico 334 050 to AT&T Comercializacion Movil.

apple_o2_ota.supports: O2 UK CarrierEntitlements endpoint https://ses.o2.co.uk:443; bundle also contains eSIM and physical-SIM-transfer entitlement metadata. This is not evidence of a giffgaff HTTPS entitlement requirement.

itu_country_mcc.supports: Official E.212 country allocations for every national MCC reused here. Only MCCs already present in the corresponding original country list are generalized. Country allocation is not a destination GeoIP or service-availability guarantee.
itu_country_mcc.verification: Official ITU OB 1117 annex downloaded directly from itu.int and its allocation tables inspected on 2026-11-23; national allocations corroborated against the original country lists. The current ITU service-publications catalog still links this consolidated MCC list; subsequent amendments must be monitored.

itu_shared_mcc.supports: Shared international MCC allocations, including 901, must not be treated as one national country. No shared international MCC occurs in the 19 baseline country lists.

surge_first_match.supports: Rules are evaluated in order; precise country routing must precede broad GeoIP fallbacks.

surge_no_resolve.supports: no-resolve does not suppress IP rules for a request whose destination is already an IP address.

additions.note: Official O2 UK bundle endpoint. Not established as a dependency or failure cause for giffgaff; the giffgaff bundle enables Wi-Fi Calling without a separate entitlement check.
